label: PancakeSwap V3 range watch
description: Check a PancakeSwap V3 pool's current tick against your position's tick range. Default **waitUntilOutOfRange** waits until the tick moves **outside** the range. Set **false** for a one-shot check (always-on ticks / Plan debug): sets inRange, driftDirection, and triggerReason (hard_oor | near_edge | in_range) and succeeds even if still in range. Service-worker ticks always one-shot.

inputs.description: V3 position NFT token ID. Template vars supported.
How often to check the current tick when waiting (default 30s).
Maximum wait time when waitUntilOutOfRange is true (0 = wait forever).
When true (default), poll until hard out-of-range. When false, one check then succeed.
Optional: while in range, treat within this % of an edge as near_edge (one-shot).

outputs.description: Row variable: 'above' or 'below' (empty when still in_range).
Row variable: JSON with tickLower, tickUpper, currentTick, direction, triggerReason, pool.

formSchema.label: V3 position NFT token ID
formSchema.hint: The token ID from a previous v3PositionMint step.

formSchema.label: Wait until out of range
formSchema.hint: Off = one-shot (sets inRange / triggerReason and continues). Always-on ticks always one-shot. Unset on old steps means wait (same as the handler default).
